essence: Durgā, Rudras, Suns, and Vasus are all to be invoked in the auspicious region
After consecrating the fire-pit fire, the officiant should perform the fire-offering
Palāśa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa woods are assigned to the directions beginning with the east
The wise best teacher should satisfy Śiva with his limbs in the principal fire-pit
Senānī is to be placed in the western fire-pit and the Suns in the fire direction
